purpose: Make the leg's ESP32-host calibration image persistent: written to the dock's SPI flash, so the dock boots it at every power-up instead of an unknown older image. Operator request after repeated SRAM losses.
motor_supply_off_reported_by_operator: Operator: 'supply off, p4 unplugged, go ahead' just before the write. The P4's USB port was absent.
fpga_image: Tang repo bridge-calibration recipe (RELEASE_TX=1, SAFETY_ENABLE=1, SAFETY_FIRST_ID=1, SAFETY_COUNT=3, CALIBRATION=1, SAFETY_FEEDBACK_TIMEOUT=20000000 (400 ms), SAFETY_COMMAND_TIMEOUT=30000000 (600 ms)) with the host UART on G7 (host_rx) and G8 (host_tx). Supervisor profile 8, the same as the leg's deployment-v8 image ae912f43; only the host pins differ.

rtl_sources.repo: ~/projects/sipeed-tang-primer-25k at 3733582 with uncommitted changes. All five sources predate the v8 image (2026-09-22 21:20), so the RTL is the same as v8.

tests_before_load.tang: make sim-calibration: PASS (SYNC length predicates; multi-axis calibration arming; continuous encoder; servo modes; calibration profile: outward-only window, PWM cap, ID isolation, command gating, watchdog, S2, temperature; reply survives inter-byte pause)
tests_before_load.tang: make sim-safety: PASS (21 safety cases; UART safety; released TX during reply)
tests_before_load.robot-link cosim: Not applicable: the robot-link engine does not send travel windows, so this profile refuses to arm it. Motion goes through the Rust calibration panel over the TCP tunnel.

flash_backup_before_write.file: dock-flash-backup-2026-10-08.bin (kept beside this receipt, excluded from git through .git/info/exclude because it is 1 MB)
flash_backup_before_write.contents: A GW5A-25 bitstream (header carries idcode 0x1281b) of 741,960 bytes. Everything after it is erased (0xFF). Which design it is was not recorded; the Tang repo's make prog targets are servo.fs and lidar.fs.
flash_backup_before_write.restore: openFPGALoader -b tangprimer25k -f --verify with that design's .fs, or write the raw dump back: openFPGALoader -b tangprimer25k --write-flash --verify --file-type bin dock-flash-backup-2026-10-08.bin (that raw-restore command is untested; supply off, P4 unplugged, new receipt)

programming: Persistent SPI flash: openFPGALoader -b tangprimer25k -f --verify, erase/write 0x00000-0xC0000, verify Done, exit 0 (00:16:27Z to 00:16:51Z)

readback.2026-10-09T12:55Z: Through the P4 (new firmware, GET /api/state fpga.version): supervisor profile 8 answering on G7/G8, latched with reason 1 (boot), nothing armed; servos silent with the motor supply off. No image has been loaded into SRAM since the flash write, so the running image is the flash's.
readback.cold_power_cycle: Not confirmed: openFPGALoader -f also reconfigures from flash after writing, so a boot latch alone does not show the dock booting it from a cold power-up. Confirm by unplugging the dock's USB for 5 s with nothing loaded, then checking profile 8 again.

host.firmware: firmware/robot-link/esp32/build/robot_link.bin: first ID 1, mask 0x7, 2 s status log, bus scan, station mode on the home network, esp_hosted pinned ^2.12.12 (resolved to 2.12.13); page STOP is written straight to the FPGA while the tunnel or bus scan owns the UART; page drive cap 1000 (see raised-limits.json)

boot_behaviour: At every power-up the FPGA boots this image latched (load/boot latch), with nothing armed and host link on G7/G8. The dock's USB UART does not host the bridge unless another image is loaded into SRAM for that session.
